header.title: How to Clean a Frying Basket
header.description: This guide provides instructions on how to effectively clean a frying basket, including creating a simple homemade degreaser to remove grease and grime.

steps.description: Prepare the deep fryer for cleaning by unplugging it, allowing it to cool, and removing the frying basket.
actions: Unplug your deep fryer.
Allow it to cool down completely.
Ensure the deep fryer has cooled down to room temperature.
Verify the deep fryer is perfectly safe to touch.
Remove your frying basket.
Set the frying basket aside.
Gather your materials.

steps.description: Clean the basket using a vinegar and water solution, wiping it down and then rinsing it off.
actions: Mix a solution that is 9/10 vinegar and 1/10 water.
Dip your cloth in the mixture.
Wipe down the basket.
Rinse off the basket.
Wash the basket in a sink or tub (if available).
Take the basket outside (if necessary).
Rinse the basket with a hose (if outside).

steps.description: This step describes how to create a homemade degreaser using baking soda and water.
actions: Get a bowl.
Put baking soda in the bowl.
Gradually add water to the baking soda.
Mix as you add water.
Stop adding water when the baking soda has the consistency of toothpaste.
Stir thoroughly to ensure no pockets of pure water or baking soda remain.

steps.description: Apply a grease-removing mixture to the fryer basket, let it sit, scrub, and rinse.
actions: Apply grease removing mixture to the basket
Cover the entire basket with the mixture
Allow the mixture to sit
Wipe off the mixture
Scrub the basket
Rinse the basket
